content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P-87421 fired — inference-gateway-usw2: aggregated 5xx rate spike (5m window > 5%). Alerts: high 502/504 fraction. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx
pagerduty: Trigger: service=inference-gateway-usw2, metric=5xx_rate, value=6.2% over 5m, triggered at <https://pd.redwood.com/incidents/P-87421|P-87421>
carla: Acked and taking oncall — looking now. @ben @sre-ryan fyi
ben: on it, tailing ingress logs and draining a stale proxy if needed
alice: any customer-facing impact yet? CS queue lighting up? @customer-success-liz
customer-success-liz: small set of requests failing for a few customers in US-W. A couple support tickets but not a widespread outage yet.
ben: quick check: top error is upstream 502 from model-proxy, stack traces show "context canceled" spikes. hitting for requests with long context lengths.
sre-ryan: possible KV cache pressure + cold workers. suggest temporary scale + spin up extra rep count in usw2-ml-pool
carla: Doing a rolling restart of the model-proxy sidecar on a subset (canary) to see if 502s drop. Will post results.
ben: command executed:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/model-proxy -l az=usw2a
``` 
started canary (10% of pods)
alice: thanks. tagging product/support: potential latency bump for embeddings.
ben: after restart, canary 502 rate dropped to 0.8% (from 6.2%) within 90s. Warm caches look healthier.
carla: good signal. expanding restart to remaining pods in a controlled rolling window. ETA ~6m
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary success — auto-escalation suppressed. Will monitor 5xx for next 10m window.
sre-ryan: also bumped desired replicas for usw2-ml-pool + enabled burst autoscale for next 20m:
```
kubectl scale deploy usw2-ml-pool --replicas=8 -n inference
``` 
should absorb transient backlog
customer-success-liz: heads-up: informed affected customers that team is investigating; standing by for updates.
oncall-marc: if this resurfaces after expansion, escalate to platform-ops and start rollback to previous routing weight to fallback model variants.
ben: current metrics: 5xx rate steady at 0.9%, tail latency slightly up (~120ms -> 210ms) but within SLO for non-critical routes. No new PD escalations.
carla: Closing handoff in 10m unless we see reoccurrence. Leaving runbook notes and steps taken in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/P-87421
alice: thx all. :thumbsup:
oncall-marc: taking final watch for next 10m then handoff to night oncall @oncall-marc
incident-bot: PD P-87421 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (monitoring). If error rate climbs above 3% again, PD will re-fire.
